title: Benowitz Kirtland video of a saucer with a PSA plane behind
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: there's one of them that looks like a saucer kind of like this. And there's a there's a there's a PSA Pacific Southwest Airlines plane flying behind it.

plain: In 1980 a man named Paul Bennewitz filmed objects near Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico, and in one clip, according to Greg Bishop, "there's one of them that looks like a saucer" with "a PSA Pacific Southwest Airlines plane flying behind it." Bishop describes the footage to Michels as someone who has seen it. A known airliner in the same shot would give a sense of the object's place and size.
